- Risks
  - Backfill accuracy for legacy records.
  - Auth misconfiguration leaking contributions or misattributing agents.
  - Log growth/perf on large genomes; need rotation later.
  - Coupling between handoff payload and UI consumers.
  - Race conditions on concurrent contribution appends without file locks.
